lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: are you a big fan of TV?
I'm obsessed with several shows, so much so that I record them so that I don't miss a single episode.
I'm not particularly interested in stories that are made up.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Wow,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: even with as busy as you are, you still find time to watch some shows?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: That's incredible.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Fictional stories can be fun sometimes.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: The reason I asked is because there's this show everyone's been talking about,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Super Doctor.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Have you heard of it?
I think I have.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: The main characters are all doctors,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: just like Mary and I.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: It's about

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: how they use miracle surgeries

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: to treat patients with serious injuries and incurable diseases.
Sounds like a lot of fun.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: It is!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: The doctors on the show only treat humans,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: so it's a little different from Mary and me,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: but I'm always invested in every single episode that I watch.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: If I keep working hard

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and expand my knowledge and skillset,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: do you think I could become like a super doctor who can cure anything?
I'm positive that you can do it.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: That's wonderful to hear you say that.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I'll keep studying hard

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: so that everyone around me can lead longer, happier,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and healthier lives!
I can't wait for that day to arrive, Super Doctor Pepper.
